evaluations.name: positive_incident_detection
evaluations.input_prompt: Service test-orphan-service in gke-skills-sandbox returns 503 / connection refused. Diagnose backend endpoints.
expected_tools: kubectl get svc -n gke-skills-sandbox test-orphan-service -o wide

expected_findings.root_cause: Label mismatch between Service selector and workload deployment pods prevents endpoint controller from registering backends.
expected_findings.remediation: Correct Service selector to match active workload deployment labels via declarative GitOps patch.

passing_criteria: Must identify 0 endpoints in Service and EndpointSlice
Must compare Service selector against pod labels in namespace
Must generate corrected declarative Service manifest

evaluations.name: complex_edge_case_and_handoff
evaluations.input_prompt: Service api-service has 3 ready endpoints, but requests return connection refused. Diagnose port mapping.
expected_tools: kubectl describe pod -l app=api-backend -n gke-skills-sandbox | grep -A 5 Ports

expected_findings.correlation: Differentiates endpoint registration failure (0 endpoints) from port routing mismatch (container listening on 8080, targetPort set to 80).
expected_findings.decision: Identifies targetPort misconfiguration; synthesizes Service manifest patch updating targetPort to match container listen port.

passing_criteria: Must inspect both Service port/targetPort and pod containerPort
Must detect port discrepancy despite healthy endpoints
Must formulate declarative patch aligning targetPort

evaluations.name: benign_condition_guardrail
evaluations.input_prompt: Service core-api in production has 4 active endpoints matching deployment pods. Is routing degraded?

expected_findings.behavior: Observes 4 ready endpoints matching healthy pods on expected port. Confirms normal routing; zero actions.

passing_criteria: Must verify EndpointSlice contains ready endpoints
